name: eyeatlas-vr-web
description: EyeAtlas VR - Responsive Web Clinician Portal with Immersive WebXR Support

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); http.createServer((req, res) => { fs.readFile('index.html', (err, data) => { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': 'text/html'}); res.end(data); }); }).listen(3000, () => console.log('Web portal running at http://localhost:3000'));"
